title: Fafa and Ancient Alphabet
statementMd:
Ancient Egyptians are known to have used a large set of symbols ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) to write on the walls of the temples. Fafa and Fifa went to one of the temples and found two non-empty words $*S*_{1}$ and $*S*_{2}$ of equal lengths on the wall of temple written one below the other. Since this temple is very ancient, some symbols from the words were erased. The symbols in the set ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) have equal probability for being in the position of any erased symbol.

Fifa challenged Fafa to calculate the probability that $*S*_{1}$ is lexicographically greater than $*S*_{2}$. Can you help Fafa with this task?

You know that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e45165853d1771bbec2e6849b3b55f0021c8d6fa.png), i. e. there were $*m*$ distinct characters in Egyptians' alphabet, in this problem these characters are denoted by integers from $1$ to $*m*$ in alphabet order. A word $*x*$ is lexicographically greater than a word $*y*$ of the same length, if the words are same up to some position, and then the word $*x*$ has a larger character, than the word $*y*$.

We can prove that the probability equals to some fraction ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png), where $*P*$ and $*Q*$ are coprime integers, and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a89b9238145afe8a88be1ad2fb4dc4a5901b1d1.png). Print as the answer the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8919f4faa13b25e67af57ddcb244a740fdc37fab.png), i. e. such a non-negative integer less than $10^{9} + 7$, such that ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b1631491bff462570ddb4b3825cc2b9ca5807ecb.png), where ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19ed9832b6e4da7413f61a1c23c79068cd8f49d1.png) means that $*a*$ and $*b*$ give the same remainders when divided by $*m*$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*,  *m* ≤ 10^{5}$) — the length of each of the two words and the size of the alphabet ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png), respectively.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *m*$) — the symbols of $*S*_{1}$. If $*a*_{*i*} = 0$, then the symbol at position $*i*$ was erased.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers representing $*S*_{2}$ with the same format as $*S*_{1}$.

## Output

Print the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/57394b93f524f97ade9fb74b302ba6833a1081c6.png), where $*P*$ and $*Q*$ are coprime and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png) is the answer to the problem.

## Note

In the first sample, the first word can be converted into ($1$) or ($2$). The second option is the only one that will make it lexicographically larger than the second word. So, the answer to the problem will be ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a762254bc6d3a2cc6ae07485c1de945962e7e524.png), that is $500000004$, because ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cbff288b4c38669aa9b8013ee25b8dde80420841.png).

In the second example, there is no replacement for the zero in the second word that will make the first one lexicographically larger. So, the answer to the problem is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a468ab19fec68399601f37993805846b7dd342ad.png), that is $0$.
statementZhMd:
众所周知，古埃及人使用一组很大的符号 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) 在神庙的墙壁上书写。Fafa 和 Fifa 来到一座神庙，在墙上发现了两个长度相等的非空单词 *S*_{1} 和 *S*_{2}，它们上下排列。由于这座神庙十分古老，单词中的一些符号已经被擦除。集合 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) 中的符号等概率地出现在任意一个被擦除符号的位置上。

Fifa 挑战 Fafa 计算 *S*_{1} 按字典序大于 *S*_{2} 的概率。你能帮助 Fafa 完成这个任务吗？

已知 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e45165853d1771bbec2e6849b3b55f0021c8d6fa.png)，即埃及人的字母表中有 *m* 个不同的字符。在本题中，这些字符按照字母表顺序用 $1$ 到 *m* 的整数表示。对于长度相同的单词 *x* 和 *y*，如果两个单词在某个位置之前都相同，并且在该位置 *x* 中的字符大于 *y* 中的字符，则称单词 *x* 按字典序大于单词 *y*。

可以证明，该概率等于某个分数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png)，其中 *P* 和 *Q* 互质，并且 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a89b9238145afe8a88be1ad2fb4dc4a5901b1d1.png)。请输出数值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8919f4faa13b25e67af57ddcb244a740fdc37fab.png)，即满足 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b1631491bff462570ddb4b3825cc2b9ca5807ecb.png) 的小于 $10^{9} + 7$ 的非负整数，其中 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/19ed9832b6e4da7413f61a1c23c79068cd8f49d1.png) 表示 *a* 和 *b* 除以 *m* 后的余数相同。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 *n* 和 *m*（$1 ≤ *n*,  *m* ≤ 10^{5}$），分别表示两个单词的长度以及字母表 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/782cb89fbe7443d4734af5f2bb9f8d15ac2ace56.png) 的大小。

第二行包含 *n* 个整数 *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}（$0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ *m$），表示 *S*_{1} 中的符号。如果 *a*_{*i*} = 0，则表示位置 *i* 的符号已被擦除。

第三行以与 *S*_{1} 相同的格式包含表示 *S*_{2} 的 *n* 个整数。

## 输出格式

输出数值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/57394b93f524f97ade9fb74b302ba6833a1081c6.png)，其中 *P* 和 *Q* 互质，且 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c774283e44990bd22fded6fe64d27b8a23c99ff.png) 是本题的答案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，第一个单词可以被替换为（$1$）或（$2$）。只有第二种情况会使它按字典序大于第二个单词。因此，本题答案为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a762254bc6d3a2cc6ae07485c1de945962e7e524.png)，即 $500000004$，因为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/cbff288b4c38669aa9b8013ee25b8dde80420841.png)。

在第二个样例中，无论将第二个单词中的零替换为何值，都无法使第一个单词按字典序更大。因此，本题答案为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a468ab19fec68399601f37993805846b7dd342ad.png)，即 $0$。
